> A compact desktop robot that translates software debugging data into physical expressions. Connected via USB-C, a background PC companion script uses Python's traceback module to catch code failures (like NameErrors or SyntaxErrors) and transmits the data over serial to an ESP32-S3. BUGBOT then uses an expressive top display for digital facial animations, a dedicated chest screen for error readouts, and integrated RGB LEDs/buzzers to guide me through fixing my code
